mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.approval_inbox(producer,event_id,tenant_id,application_id,environment,request_id,payload_hash,payload_json) VALUES(#{producer},#{event},#{p.tenantId},#{p.applicationId},#{p.environment},#{request},#{hash},#{body}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT producer,event_id,request_id,payload_hash,payload_json,status,result FROM auth_governance.approval_inbox WHERE producer=#{producer} AND event_id=#{event} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.approval_conflict(producer,event_id,payload_hash,original_hash) VALUES(#{producer},#{event},#{hash},#{original}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO auth_governance.approval_nonce(producer,nonce) VALUES(#{producer},#{nonce}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.approval_inbox SET status=#{status},result=#{result},processed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE producer=#{producer} AND event_id=#{event} AND status='RECEIVED'
